body: B1 and B2 are verified fixed, and the real dry run has no false positives. One blocking line: the .aida/config.toml cargo-reap-report job prompt ends with 'reclaim with cargo reap --apply', which tells an unattended seat to delete every 6h. Make it report-only: 'Run cargo reap (dry-run) and cargo ps; report the would-reap list and free space to the operator. Never pass --apply.' Push that one-line change and mail me. I'll verify the delta directly with no full re-review. Status update: #9 and #10 round 3 are in review now.
